pending_interview.category: Behavioral/leadership — conflict resolution, prioritization under ambiguity, influence without authority, giving hard feedback, scaling a team through change
pending_interview.question: You inherited a senior engineering team that has been running autonomously for two years under a manager who never pushed back on scope. You need to introduce a proper prioritization process — which will require the team to say no to some requests they've historically always said yes to. Two of your strongest engineers are openly skeptical, and a key internal stakeholder has already gone around you to escalate a project you deprioritized. Walk me through exactly how you would handle the next 30 days.
